subScenes.name: 礼貌开场
subScenes.description: 顾客礼貌致电，说明想预约理发服务。

qaPairs.triggerText: Can I make an appointment for a haircut?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客礼貌开场，询问预约可能性

followUps.text: Of course! What day and time works for you?
followUps.text_cn: 当然可以！您什么时间方便？

followUps.text: We're fully booked until next week, but we have a cancellation slot tomorrow at 3 PM.
followUps.text_cn: 我们下周前都约满了，但明天下午3点有个取消的空档。

followUps.text: We only take appointments on weekdays. Would you like to come in Monday?
followUps.text_cn: 我们只在工作日接受预约，您周一来可以吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于礼貌开启预约对话，适用于初次到店或电话预约场景

qaPairs.triggerText: What times do you have available this week?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 这周您有哪些空闲时间？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客主动询问可选时间段，体现明确需求

followUps.text: We have openings at 10 AM, 1 PM, and 4 PM on Tuesday, and 11 AM on Thursday.
followUps.text_cn: 周二有10点、下午1点和4点的空位，周四上午11点也有。

followUps.text: We're fully booked until Friday, but we can squeeze you in at 9 AM if you're flexible.
followUps.text_cn: 我们直到周五都约满了，但如果您能早一点，早上9点可以安排。

followUps.text: Our earliest slot is next Monday. Would you like to wait for a cancellation?
followUps.text_cn: 我们最早能排到下周一。您愿意等取消的空位吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客主动询问时间，是预约流程中最核心的提问之一

qaPairs.triggerText: Would 3 PM on Wednesday work for you?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 服务员提出具体时间，等待顾客确认

followUps.text: Yes, 3 PM works perfectly. Thank you!
followUps.text_cn: 可以，3点正好，谢谢！

followUps.text: Actually, I'm a bit busy then. Do you have anything at 5 PM?
followUps.text_cn: 不好意思，那时我有点忙，5点有空吗？

followUps.text: I'm not sure yet — can I call back tomorrow to confirm?
followUps.text_cn: 我还不确定，明天再打电话确认可以吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 服务员提出具体时间点，是预约闭环的关键环节，用户需灵活回应

subScenes.name: 询问空档
subScenes.description: 顾客询问近期可预约的时间段。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have any openings this week?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客主动询问理发店本周可预约的时间段

followUps.text: Yes, we have slots on Tuesday at 3 PM and Thursday at 11 AM.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，周二下午3点和周四上午11点有空。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, we're fully booked until next Monday.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，我们一直排到下周一才空出来。

followUps.text: Let me check our system for last-minute cancellations — I’ll get back to you in 5 minutes.
followUps.text_cn: 我查一下是否有临时取消的预约，5分钟内回复您。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客在预约前常用此句试探可用时间，服务员回应应体现真实业务状态：有空、无空、需核实。

qaPairs.triggerText: What times do you have available on Friday?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 周五有哪些时间段可以预约？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客锁定某一天，询问具体可选时间

followUps.text: We have 10 AM, 1 PM, and 4 PM open on Friday.
followUps.text_cn: 周五我们有上午10点、下午1点和4点的空档。

followUps.text: Actually, we only have 1 PM left — everything else is booked.
followUps.text_cn: 其实只剩下午1点了，其他时间都满了。

followUps.text: We don’t cut hair on Fridays — we’re closed that day.
followUps.text_cn: 我们周五不营业，那天休息。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客常锁定具体日期询问，服务员回应需真实反映排期，包括限制、唯一选项或当日关闭。

qaPairs.triggerText: Can I book an appointment for Saturday morning?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我可以预约周六上午吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客提出具体时间请求，试探是否可安排

followUps.text: Yes, we have 9 AM and 10:30 AM available.
followUps.text_cn: 可以，上午9点和10点半有空。

followUps.text: We’re fully booked for Saturday morning, but we have a slot at 2 PM if you’re flexible.
followUps.text_cn: 周六上午全满了，但下午2点有空，如果您能调整时间的话。

followUps.text: We don’t do Saturday appointments — we’re only open Monday to Friday.
followUps.text_cn: 我们周六不接预约，只在周一到周五营业。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客常提出具体时间请求，服务员回应需体现灵活性、政策限制或替代建议，反映真实预约场景的多样性。

subScenes.name: 确认时间
subScenes.description: 店员提供可选时间，顾客确认具体预约时段。

qaPairs.triggerText: What time works best for you?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 理发店预约 - 确认时间

followUps.text: How about 3 PM tomorrow?
followUps.text_cn: 明天下午3点可以吗？

followUps.text: I'm free on Saturday morning, any time before 11?
followUps.text_cn: 我周六上午有空，11点前都可以。

followUps.text: Actually, I'm busy this week — could we schedule for next Monday?
followUps.text_cn: 其实这周我都没空，能安排下周一吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于回应理发师询问可预约时间，表达个人时间偏好或调整需求。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have any availability on Thursday?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 理发店预约 - 确认时间

followUps.text: We have an opening at 10 AM or 4 PM.
followUps.text_cn: 我们上午10点或下午4点有空。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, Thursday is fully booked — how about Friday at 2 PM?
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，周四已经约满了，周五下午2点可以吗？

followUps.text: We only have a cancellation slot at 7 PM — it's last minute.
followUps.text_cn: 我们只有一个临时取消的时段，晚上7点，是临时的。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用户主动询问特定日期是否有空，服务员回应时需体现不同可用性状态。

qaPairs.triggerText: Can you make it by 9 AM?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 理发店预约 - 确认时间

followUps.text: Yes, 9 AM works perfectly.
followUps.text_cn: 可以，9点正好。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, I have a meeting then — is 10:30 possible?
followUps.text_cn: 不好意思，那时我有个会议，10:30可以吗？

followUps.text: I'm not sure yet — can I let you know by tonight?
followUps.text_cn: 我还不确定，今晚之前回复您可以吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 理发师提出具体时间点，用户根据自身安排做出不同回应，体现决策状态差异。

subScenes.name: 提供信息
subScenes.description: 顾客提供姓名与联系方式完成预约。

qaPairs.triggerText: What day and time would you like for your appointment?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您想预约哪天什么时候？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 理发店预约：服务员询问预约时间

followUps.text: Can I come in on Tuesday at 3 PM?
followUps.text_cn: 我周二下午3点来可以吗？

followUps.text: I'm free this weekend — any openings Saturday morning?
followUps.text_cn: 我周末有空，周六早上有空位吗？

followUps.text: Do you have anything tomorrow? I need it urgent.
followUps.text_cn: 明天有空位吗？我急需理发。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客回应理发师关于预约时间的询问，表达不同时间偏好或紧急程度。

qaPairs.triggerText: How long do you want your haircut to be?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 理发店预约：服务员询问发型长度偏好

followUps.text: Just a trim — keep it short but not too short.
followUps.text_cn: 只修一下边，保持短但别太短。

followUps.text: I want it buzzed short on the sides and longer on top.
followUps.text_cn: 两边剃短，上面留长一点。

followUps.text: I'm not sure — can you suggest something stylish?
followUps.text_cn: 我不确定，你有什么时尚建议吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客回应理发师关于发型长度或风格的询问，体现不同需求层次。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have a membership or discount card?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您有会员卡或优惠券吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 理发店预约：服务员询问优惠资格

followUps.text: Yes, I'm a member — my number is 789456.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，我是会员，号码是789456。

followUps.text: I don't have one, but do you offer student discounts?
followUps.text_cn: 我没有，但你们有学生优惠吗？

followUps.text: I forgot my card — can I use it next time?
followUps.text_cn: 我忘带卡了，下次能用吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客回应关于优惠资格的询问，体现不同经济或身份情境下的应对方式。

subScenes.name: 结束致谢
subScenes.description: 双方礼貌道别，确认预约成功。

qaPairs.triggerText: Thank you so much for your service!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 理发结束，服务员致谢，顾客回应

followUps.text: Thank you! I love my new haircut!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！我喜欢我的新发型！

followUps.text: You did a great job — I’ll be back next month!
followUps.text_cn: 你做得太棒了，我下个月还来！

followUps.text: Thanks, but could you just trim a bit more next time?
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，不过下次能再修短一点吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于理发服务结束时，顾客对服务员感谢的自然回应，体现满意度、忠诚度或建设性反馈

qaPairs.triggerText: Is everything okay with your cut?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 理发师在结束时确认顾客满意度，顾客回应

followUps.text: Perfect! Exactly what I wanted.
followUps.text_cn: 完美！正是我想要的。

followUps.text: It’s a little too short on the sides, but I’ll get used to it.
followUps.text_cn: 侧面有点短了，但我能适应。

followUps.text: Actually, could you fix the back? It’s uneven.
followUps.text_cn: 其实能帮我修一下后脑勺吗？有点不平。

qaPairs.usageNote: 理发师主动确认满意度时，顾客可能的回应，涵盖积极、妥协和请求调整三种典型态度

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 理发结束，服务员道别，顾客回应

followUps.text: You too! See you next time!
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！下次见！

followUps.text: Thanks, I’m heading to work now.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，我现在要去上班了。

followUps.text: I really appreciate it — you made my day!
followUps.text_cn: 真的很感谢你，你让我今天心情变好了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 服务员道别时，顾客的三种自然回应：社交性回应、实用信息补充、情感升华，体现真实人际互动层次
